about_the_game:
Ready for a clean shot?

The Sniper Weapon Pack replaces your default shotgun with a powerful sniper rifle, letting you take on the undead horde from a distance. Zoom in, aim steady, and eliminate threats with deadly accuracy.

Perfect for players who love precision, long-range kills, and a tactical approach to survival.

Includes:
– A new sniper rifle weapon
– Full compatibility with the solo campaign & the coop mode (DLC)
– A fresh way to experience Propagation VR

content_descriptors.notes: This game is set in a zombie apocalypse involving zombies, giant spiders, and other mutant monsters. It contains violence, gore, horror, mature language, and is not recommended for players under 18.
